[quote=dhornaper;59779964][B]Nightfall[/b]

Fereydun Khan wears a trenchcoat, hiding his general's uniform as he makes his way to one of Colonel Jamshid's company's barracks. When he arrives, he takes off his trenchcoat at the front entrance and identifies himself before stating he has an urgent message to personally deliver to Colonel Jamshid. The soldier unlocks the gate and lets him in.

He makes his way to the barracks' head office where Colonel Jamshid, Major Siamak, and their NCOs are assembled. He at once ordered them to assemble the company on the parade field. After the company was assembled, he announced to the enlisted soldiers that they are part of a larger coup attempt involving all units in the capital. He then gave the men a choice: they could participate or, if they objected, they could stand aside.

After a short moment where no one objected, he turned to Major Siamak and informed him of the locations his men were to occupy. They were to occupy the state broadcaster, the Presidential palace, and the Majlis building. He turned towards Colonel Jamshid and ordered him to get his other units to occupy the airport, the offices for the Ministry of Defence and the Directorate of Intelligence, preapre to shut off internet access across the country, occupy the other major broadcasters, the police headquarters, and to control the air force base just outside the capital.

With that, Colonel Jamshid set off to issue orders to his other companies and General Fereydun got into an army truck with Major Siamak as they drove their part of the company to the state broadcaster.[/quote]

[B]Outside the State Broadcaster[/b]
[I]Two hours later...[/i]

The drive to the state broadcaster was uneventful with few civilians encountered. General Fereydun radios Colonel Jamshid. "Has the air force been brought along, the Directorate of Intelligence neutralised, the other broadcasters prepared to relay the message, and the internet network service providers including our military network been occupied?" After a brief moment, Colonel Jamshid responds "Yes sir, all targets have been occupied and the broadcasters have been prepared to relay the message they receive from the state broadcaster."

With all targets secured, General Fereydun, Major Siamak, and their men got out of the truck just in front of the state broadcaster.

"Enter the building and stop anyone from coming in or getting out. Got it?" Orders General Fereydun. "Yes sir." Responds Major Siamak as he barks orders at his men to enter and secure the building and prevent any one from entering or leaving.

General Fereydun walks in with the enlisted soldiers and makes his way to the reception. "I need to talk with the director urgently, where is he?" He says arching down towards the receptionist. "Third floor room 40." The receptionist responds with a waver in their voice.

General Fereydun quickly makes his way to the director's office with two soldiers flanking him. When he arrives, he bursts in and demands to be taken to the news studio immediately to issue a national notice. The director doesn't have time to think it over as General Fereydun grabs him by the shoulder and forces him out of the door.

The nervous director guides General Fereydun to the news studio where the live broadcast is being shot. "Put it on hold, and prepare it so I can deliver an urgent message to the nation." The director hesitates before complying. The live broadcast is replaced with a message reading "This broadcast will be back in a few minutes..."
